title: Snake
description: The classic game, reimagined. Eat, grow, survive.
longDescription: Guide your snake to eat food and grow as long as possible without hitting walls or yourself. Choose from multiple difficulty levels, grid sizes, and snake skins. Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard — and watch out for power-ups.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic strategy across 3 board sizes. Beat an unbeatable AI — or a friend.
longDescription: Three board sizes (Classic 3×3, Extended 5×5, Gomoku 15×15), four AI difficulty levels — including a full minimax Unbeatable mode — plus series play, power-ups, and turn timers. 28 unique player avatars. Track your match history and player stats across every session.

title: Nexus
description: Guess the hidden category from 5 mystery clues. The fewer hints you need, the higher you score.
longDescription: Nexus reveals clue words one at a time — each one pointing toward a hidden category. Guess correctly on the first hint for the maximum score of 500 points. Six modes including Daily challenge, Streak, and Time Attack keep gameplay fresh.

title: Flappy Bird
description: Tap to flap through pipes. 7 difficulty stages, 6 power-ups, 14 skins, and 8 parallax worlds.
longDescription: The timeless one-tap challenge, fully loaded. Navigate your bird through an endless gauntlet of pipes that get faster and tighter as you score higher. Collect coins, gems, and stars mid-flight. Grab power-ups like Shield, Ghost, and Slow-Mo to survive longer. Unlock 14 bird skins and 8 parallax backgrounds. Complete 4 collection sets to earn exclusive skins. Chase 18 achievements and climb the leaderboard.

description: Slide and merge tiles to reach 2048. Simple rules, deep strategy.
longDescription: The iconic number-merging puzzle — rebuilt with five grid sizes, six game modes, themed tile sets, color palettes, animated score popups, a daily challenge, achievements, and calm procedural music for long thinking sessions.

title: Tetris
description: Stack, clear, survive. The most iconic puzzle game ever made.
longDescription: The definitive block-stacking game — with modern SRS rotation and classic NES mode, five game modes, T-spins, combos, perfect clears, eight block skins, eight parallax backgrounds, and procedural chiptune music that speeds up as you level up.
